behaviors.behavior: Wordless implement/investigate/spec cards (a tool-only turn with no explanatory text) are filtered from the feed instead of rendering as empty clutter
A dropped wordless card's real artifact summary still backfills a replacement card, and its command-chip evidence (commands/commandCount) is preserved onto that replacement rather than lost
behaviors.evidence: missionActivityFeed.test.ts — round-6 regression test asserting commands survive the drop+backfill cycle

behaviors.behavior: The user's own typed replies (non-slash-command human turns) render as "You"-kind cards in the feed
A well-formed /shipwright-iterate slash-command invocation is reclassified to kind "slash-command" upstream of humanText/buildUserReplyCard, so it is never dropped or misrendered as a plain user turn
behaviors.evidence: missionActivityFeedTurn.test.ts — explicit test proving parseSessionJsonl reclassification precedes this file's functions

behaviors.behavior: <local-command-stderr> injected noise is stripped from a human turn like the other INJECTED tags
behaviors.evidence: missionActivityFeedTurn.test.ts new filtering test; narrator-facts.ts INJECTED list

behaviors.behavior: The /shipwright-iterate intro banner (verbatim real 12-line text) is fully stripped from a pure banner turn with no leftover, and gets its own "Started a /shipwright-iterate run." goal card
A combined banner+narration turn preserves the turn's own real narration text instead of losing it to the banner-strip
Narration immediately adjacent to the banner (no blank line separator) that happens to start with a banner-like line (e.g. "Complexity:") still survives the strip
A transcript segment that reprints the banner (resumed/replayed session) does not fabricate a second duplicate goal card
Trailing narration with no following tool call flushes as a closing "system" card, gated off while the run is confirmed still live to avoid mid-run flicker
behaviors.evidence: missionActivityFeedTurn.test.ts splitTurn cases + MissionActivityFeed.test.tsx end-of-transcript flush assertion

behaviors.behavior: Every blocker card carries a live/ended/loading-aware explanation of what happened and whether it needs the user's interaction, instead of rendering red with no information
behaviors.evidence: missionActivityFeed.test.ts blocker-context coverage across live/ended/null contexts

behaviors.behavior: A spec card with only "Open Spec" and no other content is omitted from the feed
A wordless reviewer-spawn Task card synthesizes a "Spawned the reviewer..." sentence naming the reviewer instead of jumping straight to a verdict with no lead-in
The "Delivered" success box and the "Open commit" link beneath it render with visible spacing instead of being cramped together
behaviors.evidence: CSS sibling-combinator rule (.mc-feed-pr + .mc-story-link) traced against the real DOM element type (a <button>, UA-default inline-block, so margin-top has real effect); no dedicated visual/E2E assertion — documented as a traced non-issue in the ADR's Rejected Alternatives section, per external reviewer request

behaviors.behavior: The full JSONL → reducer → DOM chain renders the fixed feed correctly in a real browser, including the command-chip expand/collapse toggle for a consolidated implement card
behaviors.evidence: mission-feed-transcript-fidelity.spec.ts (Playwright, real Chromium, 5 scenarios); F0.5 surface_verification exit_code 0, 5/5 passed

surface_verification.justification: The bug report (Sven, German, reviewing a real iterate session's Mission tab) is about real-rendered transcript-to-feed fidelity that a synthetic unit fixture cannot fully prove — it only proves the reducer's output shape, not that the actual JSONL → parser → reducer → DOM chain renders it. mission-feed-transcript-fidelity.spec.ts drives the real Mission tab in a real Chromium (client/e2e/isolated-stack.mjs) against seeded transcripts covering the consolidated-command card (with its expand/collapse chip), a user-reply card, the banner-derived goal card, a blocker card's explanation text, and the closing system card.
